fact_text: A pip is the smallest standard price move in a currency pair; for EUR/USD it is the fourth decimal place.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Understanding PMEX: Pips, Spread, Initial & Maintenance Margin | Pakistan Mercantile Exchange' (YouTube, 2025-01-18)

fact_text: The ask is the price sellers offer at and the bid is the price buyers pay; buying at the ask and closing at the bid starts a position in loss by the spread.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Understanding PMEX: Pips, Spread, Initial & Maintenance Margin | Pakistan Mercantile Exchange' (YouTube, 2025-01-18)

fact_text: The analyst illustrated a 4-pip spread on the EUR/USD contract, with the bid and ask four pips apart.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Understanding PMEX: Pips, Spread, Initial & Maintenance Margin | Pakistan Mercantile Exchange' (YouTube, 2025-01-18)

fact_text: Each pip on a EUR/USD contract is worth one US dollar of profit or loss per contract, according to the analyst.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Understanding PMEX: Pips, Spread, Initial & Maintenance Margin | Pakistan Mercantile Exchange' (YouTube, 2025-01-18)

fact_text: Contract names such as Gold EUR/USD are misleading: the EUR/USD contract is priced only on the euro and the dollar, not on gold.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Understanding PMEX: Pips, Spread, Initial & Maintenance Margin | Pakistan Mercantile Exchange' (YouTube, 2025-01-18)

fact_text: On the gold contract the bid-ask spread was 30 cents, and the analyst said the same 30-cent spread appears on the 1, 10 and 100 ounce contracts.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Understanding PMEX: Pips, Spread, Initial & Maintenance Margin | Pakistan Mercantile Exchange' (YouTube, 2025-01-18)

fact_text: Initial margin is the amount a client must deposit to open a contract, and maintenance margin is the reserve that must stay in the account to hold it.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Understanding PMEX: Pips, Spread, Initial & Maintenance Margin | Pakistan Mercantile Exchange' (YouTube, 2025-01-18)

fact_text: According to the analyst, PMEX automatically closes a position once its loss reaches 50%, which protects the rest of the client's funds.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Understanding PMEX: Pips, Spread, Initial & Maintenance Margin | Pakistan Mercantile Exchange' (YouTube, 2025-01-18)
